NKJV.1: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city; God will appoint salvation for walls and bulwarks.
NKJV.2: Open the gates, That the righteous nation which keeps the truth may enter in.
NKJV.3: You will keep him in perfect peace, Whose mind is stayed on You, Because he trusts in You.
NKJV.4: Trust in the LORD forever, For in YAH, the LORD, is everlasting strength.
NKJV.5: For He brings down those who dwell on high,  The lofty city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He brings it down to the dust.
NKJV.6: The foot shall tread it down— The feet of the poor And the steps of the needy.”
NKJV.7: The way of the just is uprightness; O Most Upright, You weigh the path of the just.
NKJV.8: Yes, in the way of Your judgments, O LORD, we have waited for You; The desire of our soul is for Your name And for the remembrance of You.
NKJV.9: With my soul I have desired You in the night, Yes, by my spirit within me I will seek You early; For when Your judgments are in the earth, The inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
NKJV.10: Let grace be shown to the wicked, Yet he will not learn righteousness; In the land of uprightness he will deal unjustly, And will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
NKJV.11: LORD, when Your hand is lifted up, they will not see. But they will see and be ashamed For their envy of people; Yes, the fire of Your enemies shall devour them.
NKJV.12: LORD, You will establish peace for us, For You have also done all our works in us.
NKJV.13: O LORD our God, masters besides You Have had dominion over us; But by You only we make mention of Your name.
NKJV.14: They are dead, they will not live; They are deceased, they will not rise. Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And made all their memory to perish.
NKJV.15: You have increased the nation, O LORD, You have increased the nation; You are glorified; You have expanded all the borders of the land.
NKJV.16: LORD, in trouble they have visited You, They poured out a prayer when Your chastening was upon them.
NKJV.17: As a woman with child Is in pain and cries out in her pangs, When she draws near the time of her delivery, So have we been in Your sight, O LORD.
NKJV.18: We have been with child, we have been in pain; We have, as it were, brought forth wind; We have not accomplished any deliverance in the earth, Nor have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
NKJV.19: Your dead shall live; Together with my dead body they shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in dust; For your dew is like the dew of herbs, And the earth shall cast out the dead.
NKJV.20: Come, my people, enter your chambers, And shut your doors behind you; Hide yourself, as it were, for a little moment, Until the indignation is past.
NKJV.21: For behold, the LORD comes out of His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; The earth will also disclose her blood, And will no more cover her slain.

NASB.1: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: 'We have a strong city; He sets up walls and ramparts for security.
NASB.2: 'Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter, The one that remains faithful.
NASB.3: 'The steadfast of mind You will keep in perfect peace, Because he trusts in You.
NASB.4: 'Trust in the LORD forever, For in GOD the LORD, [we have] an everlasting Rock.
NASB.5: 'For He has brought low those who dwell on high, the unassailable city; He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He casts it to the dust.
NASB.6: 'The foot will trample it, The feet of the afflicted, the steps of the helpless.'
NASB.7: The way of the righteous is smooth; O Upright One, make the path of the righteous level.
NASB.8: Indeed, [while following] the way of Your judgments, O LORD, We have waited for You eagerly; Your name, even Your memory, is the desire of [our] souls.
NASB.9: At night my soul longs for You, Indeed, my spirit within me seeks You diligently; For when the earth experiences Your judgments The inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
NASB.10: [Though] the wicked is shown favor, He does not learn righteousness; He deals unjustly in the land of uprightness, And does not perceive the majesty of the LORD.
NASB.11: O LORD, Your hand is lifted up [yet] they do not see it. They see [Your] zeal for the people and are put to shame; Indeed, fire will devour Your enemies.
NASB.12: LORD, You will establish peace for us, Since You have also performed for us all our works.
NASB.13: O LORD our God, other masters besides You have ruled us; [But] through You alone we confess Your name.
NASB.14: The dead will not live, the departed spirits will not rise; Therefore You have punished and destroyed them, And You have wiped out all remembrance of them.
NASB.15: You have increased the nation, O LORD, You have increased the nation, You are glorified; You have extended all the borders of the land.
NASB.16: O LORD, they sought You in distress; They could only whisper a prayer, Your chastening was upon them.
NASB.17: As the pregnant woman approaches [the time] to give birth, She writhes [and] cries out in her labor pains, Thus were we before You, O LORD.
NASB.18: We were pregnant, we writhed [in labor], We gave birth, as it seems, [only] to wind. We could not accomplish deliverance for the earth, Nor were inhabitants of the world born.
NASB.19: Your dead will live; Their corpses will rise. You who lie in the dust, awake and shout for joy, For your dew [is as] the dew of the dawn, And the earth will give birth to the departed spirits.
NASB.20: Come, my people, enter into your rooms And close your doors behind you; Hide for a little while Until indignation runs [its] course.
NASB.21: For behold, the LORD is about to come out from His place To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; And the earth will reveal her bloodshed And will no longer cover her slain.

ESV.1: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city; he sets up salvation as walls and bulwarks.
ESV.2: Open the gates, that the righteous nation that keeps faith may enter in.
ESV.3: You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you, because he trusts in you.
ESV.4: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD GOD is an everlasting rock.
ESV.5: For he has humbled the inhabitants of the height, the lofty city. He lays it low, lays it low to the ground, casts it to the dust.
ESV.6: The foot tramples it, the feet of the poor, the steps of the needy.”
ESV.7: The path of the righteous is level; you make level the way of the righteous.
ESV.8: In the path of your judgments, O LORD, we wait for you; your name and remembrance are the desire of our soul.
ESV.9: My soul yearns for you in the night; my spirit within me earnestly seeks you. For when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
ESV.10: If favor is shown to the wicked, he does not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness he deals corruptly and does not see the majesty of the LORD.
ESV.11: O LORD, your hand is lifted up, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people, and be ashamed. Let the fire for your adversaries consume them.
ESV.12: O LORD, you will ordain peace for us, for you have indeed done for us all our works.
ESV.13: O LORD our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us, but your name alone we bring to remembrance.
ESV.14: They are dead, they will not live; they are shades, they will not arise; to that end you have visited them with destruction and wiped out all remembrance of them.
ESV.15: But you have increased the nation, O LORD, you have increased the nation; you are glorified; you have enlarged all the borders of the land.
ESV.16: O LORD, in distress they sought you; they poured out a whispered prayer when your discipline was upon them.
ESV.17: Like a pregnant woman who writhes and cries out in her pangs when she is near to giving birth, so were we because of you, O LORD;
ESV.18: we were pregnant, we writhed, but we have given birth to wind. We have accomplished no deliverance in the earth, and the inhabitants of the world have not fallen.
ESV.19: Your dead shall live; their bodies shall rise. You who dwell in the dust, awake and sing for joy! For your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the dead.
ESV.20: Come, my people, enter your chambers, and shut your doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until the fury has passed by.
ESV.21: For behold, the LORD is coming out from his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity, and the earth will disclose the blood shed on it, and will no more cover its slain.

NLT.1:
In that day, everyone in the land of Judah will sing this song: Our city is strong!
We are surrounded by the walls of God’s salvation.
NLT.2:
Open the gates to all who are righteous;
allow the faithful to enter.
NLT.3:
You will keep in perfect peace
all who trust in you,
all whose thoughts are fixed on you!
NLT.4:
Trust in the LORD always,
for the LORD GOD is the eternal Rock.
NLT.5:
He humbles the proud
and brings down the arrogant city.
He brings it down to the dust.
NLT.6:
The poor and oppressed trample it underfoot,
and the needy walk all over it.
NLT.7:
But for those who are righteous,
the way is not steep and rough.
You are a God who does what is right,
and you smooth out the path ahead of them.
NLT.8:
LORD, we show our trust in you by obeying your laws;
our heart’s desire is to glorify your name.
NLT.9:
In the night I search for you;
in the morning I earnestly seek you.
For only when you come to judge the earth
will people learn what is right.
NLT.10:
Your kindness to the wicked
does not make them do good.
Although others do right, the wicked keep doing wrong
and take no notice of the LORD’s majesty.
NLT.11:
O LORD, they pay no attention to your upraised fist.
Show them your eagerness to defend your people.
Then they will be ashamed.
Let your fire consume your enemies.
NLT.12:
LORD, you will grant us peace;
all we have accomplished is really from you.
NLT.13:
O LORD our God, others have ruled us,
but you alone are the one we worship.
NLT.14:
Those we served before are dead and gone.
Their departed spirits will never return!
You attacked them and destroyed them,
and they are long forgotten.
NLT.15:
O LORD, you have made our nation great;
yes, you have made us great.
You have extended our borders,
and we give you the glory!
NLT.16:
LORD, in distress we searched for you.
We prayed beneath the burden of your discipline.
NLT.17:
Just as a pregnant woman
writhes and cries out in pain as she gives birth,
so were we in your presence, LORD.
NLT.18:
We, too, writhe in agony,
but nothing comes of our suffering.
We have not given salvation to the earth,
nor brought life into the world.
NLT.19:
But those who die in the LORD will live;
their bodies will rise again!
Those who sleep in the earth
will rise up and sing for joy!
For your life-giving light will fall like dew
on your people in the place of the dead!
NLT.20:
Go home, my people,
and lock your doors!
Hide yourselves for a little while
until the LORD’s anger has passed.
NLT.21:
Look! The LORD is coming from heaven
to punish the people of the earth for their sins.
The earth will no longer hide those who have been killed.
They will be brought out for all to see.

AMP.1:
In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
"We have a strong city;
He sets up salvation as walls and ramparts.
AMP.2:
"Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter,
The one that remains faithful and trustworthy.
AMP.3:
"You will keep in perfect and constant peace the one whose mind is steadfast [that is, committed and focused on You—in both inclination and character],
Because he trusts and takes refuge in You [with hope and confident expectation].
AMP.4:
"Trust [confidently] in the LORD forever [He is your fortress, your shield, your banner],
For the Lord God is an everlasting Rock [the Rock of Ages].
AMP.5:
"For He has thrown down the [arrogant] ones who dwell on high, the lofty and inaccessible city;
He lays it low, He lays it low to the ground, He hurls it to the dust.
AMP.6:
"The foot will trample it,
Even the feet of the suffering, and the steps of the helpless."
AMP.7:
The way of the righteous [those in right-standing with God—living in moral and spiritual integrity] is smooth and level;
O Upright One, make a level path for the just and righteous.
AMP.8:
Indeed, in the path of Your judgments, O LORD,
We have waited expectantly for You;
Your name, even Your memory, is the desire and deep longing of our souls.
AMP.9:
In the night my soul longs for You [O LORD],
Indeed, my spirit within me seeks You diligently;
For [only] when Your judgments are experienced on the earth
Will the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
AMP.10:
Though the wicked is shown compassion and favor,
He does not learn righteousness;
In the land of uprightness he deals unjustly,
And refuses to see the majesty of the LORD.
AMP.11:
Though Your hand is lifted up [to strike], O LORD, the wicked do not see it.
Let them see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame;
Indeed, let the fire reserved for Your enemies consume them.
AMP.12:
LORD, You will establish peace for us,
Since You have also performed for us all that we have done.
AMP.13:
O LORD our God, other masters besides You have ruled over us;
But through You alone we confess Your name.
AMP.14:
The [wicked] dead will not live [again], the spirits of the dead will not rise and return;
Therefore You have punished and destroyed them,
And You have wiped out every memory of them [every trace of them].
AMP.15:
You have increased the nation, O LORD;
You have increased the nation, You are glorified;
You have extended all the borders of the land.
AMP.16:
O LORD, they sought You in distress;
They managed only a prayerful whisper
When Your discipline was upon them.
AMP.17:
As a woman with child approaches the time to give birth,
She is in pain and struggles and cries out in her labor,
So we were before You, O LORD.
AMP.18:
We have been with child, we have twisted and struggled in labor;
We gave birth, as it seems, only to wind.
We could not accomplish salvation for the earth,
Nor were inhabitants of the world born.
AMP.19:
Your dead will live;
Their dead bodies will rise.
You who lie in the dust, awake and shout for joy!
For your dew is a dew of [celestial] light [heavenly, supernatural],
And the earth will give birth to the spirits of the dead.
AMP.20:
Come, my people, enter your chambers
And shut your doors behind you;
Hide for a little while
Until the [Lord's] wrath is past.
AMP.21:
Listen carefully, the LORD is about to come out of His [heavenly] place
To punish the inhabitants of the earth for their wickedness [their sin, their injustice, their wrongdoing];
The earth will reveal the [innocent] blood shed upon her
And will no longer cover her slain.

WEB.1: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
WEB.2: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
WEB.3: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
WEB.4: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
WEB.5: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
WEB.6: The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”
WEB.7: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
WEB.8: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
WEB.9: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
WEB.10: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
WEB.11: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
WEB.12: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
WEB.13: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
WEB.14: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
WEB.15: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
WEB.16: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
WEB.17: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.
WEB.18: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
WEB.19: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
WEB.20: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
WEB.21: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

MSG.1:
At that time, this song
will be sung in the country of Judah:
We have a strong city, Salvation City,
built and fortified with salvation.
MSG.2:
Throw wide the gates
so good and true people can enter.
MSG.3:
People with their minds set on you,
you keep completely whole,
Steady on their feet,
because they keep at it and don't quit.
MSG.4:
Depend on God and keep at it
because in the Lord God you have a sure thing.
MSG.5:
Those who lived high and mighty
he knocked off their high horse.
He used the city built on the hill
as fill for the marshes.
MSG.6:
All the exploited and outcast peoples
build their lives on the reclaimed land.
MSG.7:
The path of right-living people is level.
The Leveler evens the road for the right-living.
MSG.8:
We're in no hurry, God. We're content to linger
in the path sign-posted with your decisions.
Who you are and what you've done
are all we'll ever want.
MSG.9:
Through the night my soul longs for you.
Deep from within me my spirit reaches out to you.
When your decisions are on public display,
everyone learns how to live right.
MSG.10:
If the wicked are shown grace,
they don't seem to get it.
In the land of right living, they persist in wrong living,
blind to the splendor of God.
MSG.11:
You hold your hand up high, God,
but they don't see it.
Open their eyes to what you do,
to see your zealous love for your people.
Shame them. Light a fire under them.
Get the attention of these enemies of yours.
MSG.12:
God, order a peaceful and whole life for us
because everything we've done, you've done for us.
MSG.13:
O God, our God, we've had other masters rule us,
but you're the only Master we've ever known.
MSG.14:
The dead don't talk,
ghosts don't walk,
Because you've said, "Enough—that's all for you,"
and wiped them off the books.
MSG.15:
But the living you make larger than life.
The more life you give, the more glory you display,
and stretch the borders to accommodate more living!
MSG.16:
O God, they begged you for help when they were in trouble,
when your discipline was so heavy
they could barely whisper a prayer.
MSG.17:
Like a woman having a baby,
writhing in distress, screaming her pain
as the baby is being born,
That's how we were because of you, O God.
MSG.18:
We were pregnant full-term.
We writhed in labor but bore no baby.
We gave birth to wind.
Nothing came of our labor.
We produced nothing living.
We couldn't save the world.
MSG.19:
But friends, your dead will live,
your corpses will get to their feet.
All you dead and buried,
wake up! Sing!
Your dew is morning dew
catching the first rays of sun,
The earth bursting with life,
giving birth to the dead.
MSG.20:
Come, my people, go home
and shut yourselves in.
Go into seclusion for a while
until the punishing wrath is past,
MSG.21:
Because God is sure to come from his place
to punish the wrong of the people on earth.
Earth itself will point out the bloodstains;
it will show where the murdered have been hidden away.

NET.1: At that time this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city! The LORD’s deliverance, like walls and a rampart, makes it secure.
NET.2: Open the gates so a righteous nation can enter — one that remains trustworthy.
NET.3: You keep completely safe the people who maintain their faith, for they trust in you.
NET.4: Trust in the LORD from this time forward, even in Yah, the LORD, an enduring protector!
NET.5: Indeed, the LORD knocks down those who live in a high place, he brings down an elevated town; he brings it down to the ground, he throws it down to the dust.
NET.6: It is trampled underfoot by the feet of the oppressed, by the soles of the poor.”
NET.7: The way of the righteous is level, the path of the righteous that you make is straight.
NET.8: Yes, as your judgments unfold, O LORD, we wait for you. We desire your fame and reputation to grow.
NET.9: I look for you during the night, my spirit within me seeks you at dawn, for when your judgments come upon the earth, those who live in the world learn about justice.
NET.10: If the wicked are shown mercy, they do not learn about justice. Even in a land where right is rewarded, they act unjustly; they do not see the LORD’s majesty revealed.
NET.11: O LORD, you are ready to act, but they don’t even notice. They will see and be put to shame by your angry judgment against humankind, yes, fire will consume your enemies.
NET.12: O LORD, you make us secure, for even all we have accomplished, you have done for us.
NET.13: O LORD, our God, masters other than you have ruled us, but we praise your name alone.
NET.14: The dead do not come back to life, the spirits of the dead do not rise. That is because you came in judgment and destroyed them, you wiped out all memory of them.
NET.15: You have made the nation larger, O LORD, you have made the nation larger and revealed your splendor, you have extended all the borders of the land.
NET.16: O LORD, in distress they looked for you; they uttered incantations because of your discipline.
NET.17: As when a pregnant woman gets ready to deliver and strains and cries out because of her labor pains, so were we because of you, O LORD.
NET.18: We were pregnant, we strained, we gave birth, as it were, to wind. We cannot produce deliverance on the earth; people to populate the world are not born.
NET.19: Your dead will come back to life; your corpses will rise up. Wake up and shout joyfully, you who live in the ground! For you will grow like plants drenched with the morning dew, and the earth will bring forth its dead spirits.
NET.20: Go, my people! Enter your inner rooms! Close your doors behind you! Hide for a little while, until his angry judgment is over!
NET.21: For look, the LORD is coming out of the place where he lives, to punish the sin of those who live on the earth. The earth will display the blood shed on it; it will no longer cover up its slain.

NIV.1:
A Song of Praise
In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
We have a strong city;
God makes salvation
its walls and ramparts.
NIV.2:
Open the gates
that the righteous nation may enter,
the nation that keeps faith.
NIV.3:
You will keep in perfect peace
him whose mind is steadfast,
because he trusts in you.
NIV.4:
Trust in the Lord forever,
for the Lord, the Lord, is the Rock eternal.
NIV.5:
He humbles those who dwell on high,
he lays the lofty city low;
he levels it to the ground
and casts it down to the dust.
NIV.6:
Feet trample it down—
the feet of the oppressed,
the footsteps of the poor.
NIV.7:
The path of the righteous is level;
O upright One, you make the way of the righteous smooth.
NIV.8:
Yes, Lord, walking in the way of your laws,
we wait for you;
your name and renown
are the desire of our hearts.
NIV.9:
My soul yearns for you in the night;
in the morning my spirit longs for you.
When your judgments come upon the earth,
the people of the world learn righteousness.
NIV.10:
Though grace is shown to the wicked,
they do not learn righteousness;
even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil
and regard not the majesty of the Lord.
NIV.11:
O Lord, your hand is lifted high,
but they do not see it.
Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame;
let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.
NIV.12:
Lord, you establish peace for us;
all that we have accomplished you have done for us.
NIV.13:
O Lord, our God, other lords besides you have ruled over us,
but your name alone do we honor.
NIV.14:
They are now dead, they live no more;
those departed spirits do not rise.
You punished them and brought them to ruin;
you wiped out all memory of them.
NIV.15:
You have enlarged the nation, O Lord;
you have enlarged the nation.
You have gained glory for yourself;
you have extended all the borders of the land.
NIV.16:
Lord, they came to you in their distress;
when you disciplined them,
they could barely whisper a prayer.
NIV.17:
As a woman with child and about to give birth
writhes and cries out in her pain,
so were we in your presence, O Lord.
NIV.18:
We were with child, we writhed in pain,
but we gave birth to wind.
We have not brought salvation to the earth;
we have not given birth to people of the world.
NIV.19:
But your dead will live;
their bodies will rise.
You who dwell in the dust,
wake up and shout for joy.
Your dew is like the dew of the morning;
the earth will give birth to her dead.
NIV.20:
Go, my people, enter your rooms
and shut the doors behind you;
hide yourselves for a little while
until his wrath has passed by.
NIV.21:
See, the Lord is coming out of his dwelling
to punish the people of the earth for their sins.
The earth will disclose the blood shed upon her;
she will conceal her slain no longer.
